lines.name: Setup line
lines.text: Well, first you would need nearly five million people, standing three feet apart the whole way.

lines.name: Punchline
lines.text: And after all that, the pool would finally be full with what was basically cross-country soup.

voices.name: Playful curious explainer
voices.design: An energetic, playful American male narrator in his late twenties, like a popular 'what if' science explainer on social media. Curious and amused, lively pitch that rises on surprising facts, crisp diction, medium-fast pace, a hint of a grin in the voice.

voices.name: Deep documentary narrator
voices.design: A deep, resonant American male narrator in his thirties with a documentary tone. Confident and smooth, close to the microphone, measured pace with dramatic weight on key numbers, a touch of dry humour.

voices.name: Upbeat young creator
voices.design: A bright, upbeat young American male voice in his early twenties, casual and quick like a TikTok creator telling a fun fact. Expressive and animated but natural, clear and friendly.

voices.name: Deadpan storyteller
voices.design: A calm, dry, deadpan American male voice in his thirties, telling an absurd hypothetical completely straight. Mid-low pitch, steady pace, subtle comic timing, slight pauses before the punchline.

voices.name: Warm friendly narrator
voices.design: A warm, friendly American male narrator in his early thirties, mid pitch, smooth and polished like a YouTube explainer voiceover. Engaging and expressive with clear articulation, medium pace.
